title: 25 Years Since 9/11, Emirates Finally Gets Berlin, and JetBlue Hits Pause on Growth
summary: It's the 25th anniversary of 9/11, and we look at how the day still shapes everything from cockpit doors to TSA water bottle rules — plus a wild story about a Korean Air 747 almost getting shot down hours after the attacks. Also today: Emirates wins its Berlin fight while Algeria slams its airspace shut on UAE carriers, and JetBlue quietly pushes 44 new jets off into the future.
